subject: Mathematics
theme: Shapes and colours in my community

source.topic: Shapes and colours in my community: Numeracy

show.line: This is six. Six windows on the taxi. One, two, three, four, five, six!

rounds.prompt: Count the eggs in the box. How many?
One, two, three, four, five. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Six! One, two, three, four, five, six.

rounds.prompt: Draw six with your finger. Curl down, then round into a ball at the bottom.

hints: Six comes after five. One, two, three, four, five, six.
Touch each one as you count.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the taxi windows.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven windows!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I counted one window twice. There are six.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together, one at a time. One, two, three, four, five, six!

parent_line: Can recognise, count and trace the number 6.
